reports.title: David Mason: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: We note your suggestion that the issues raised in your report should be considered in the development of our new guideline on adrenal insufficiency, particularly that replacement steroid therapy must be given to patients with adrenal insufficiency who have suffered trauma or physiological stress.
promises.summary: Develop guideline on adrenal insufficiency covering emergency management and prevention of adrenal crisis after trauma.

promises.quote: recommend that all health and care providers ensure their organization has put processes in place to ensure the four actions on the National Patient Safety Alert have been addressed.
promises.summary: Implement National Patient Safety Alert actions for steroid emergency cards and triage.
